answer: Stake-weighted identity makes Sybil farming uneconomical: every agent must lock collateral that slashing can destroy, so fake accounts cannot conjure influence from nothing. A botnet of cloned juniper actors still draws from one finite bond pool, and splitting that pool never amplifies its vote. Newly minted keys find no haven here, each begins at nadir trust until costly, attributable work earns weight, so the attacker pays for every identity.
